Read and write a report's YAML file

Source: R/spec_yaml.R
tfl_read_output.Rd

tfl_read_output() reads spec/outputs/<id>.yml: the !r and !unset tags become tfl_r() and tfl_unset(), a {fn:, args:} map a tfl_call(), and each item of content: (- plan_cells: {...}) a tfl_item() with from = "own". A file whose top is outputs: holds several reports (a family written in one go): a list of them comes back, each with the file's base: merged under it as a plain list (the layering with defaults is not done here). tfl_write_output() writes one report back in the same form.

Usage

tfl_read_output(path)

tfl_write_output(x, path)

Arguments

path

The file.

x

A tfl_output.

Value

tfl_read_output(): a tfl_output, or a list of them. tfl_write_output(): path, invisibly.

Several objects in one report

One report (one RTF) can hold several objects – tables, figures – on its pages: contents: in place of content: names them. An object is a list of items (it reads the report's data: / ard:), or a map of kind, data, content, template, plot (its own data: a figure's steps, a template). Its kind, when not said, is what its items make (table_plan a table) or its template's. The report's page: layout: rows say each object's place, as rtfreporter::rtf_tables() / rtf_figures() take it: object (its name), page_break (each after the first goes on under the one before unless true), space_before, first_rows, cont_title (a table's), titles, footnotes (the object's own, as page: titles: writes them), width_in, height_in (a figure's). The report's page: titles: go above the first object, its page: footnotes: below the last. tfl_run_output() makes the RTF; tfl_output_contents() builds the objects.

contents:
  demog: [{table_plan: {cols: TRT01A}}, ...]
  km:
    data: {steps: [{step: read, dataset: ADTTE}, {step: param, value: OS}]}
    template: {name: km_survival, args: {by: TRT01A}}
page:
  layout:
    - {object: demog}
    - {object: km, page_break: false, space_before: 1, height_in: 3}

Examples

f <- system.file("extdata", "spec-yaml", "outputs", "T-14-1-1.yml", package = "tflspec")
out <- tfl_read_output(f)
out$content[[1]]
#> <tfl_item> table_plan(cols, rows)
